title: F-star family gap: Lemma BPP's without-loss question answered NO - box-completeness fails at tau >= 1, minimal counterexample v = 3 (no kappa)
body:
# F-star family gap: Lemma BPP's without-loss question answered NO - box-completeness fails at tau >= 1, minimal counterexample v = 3 (no kappa)

## Scope

Kappa-blocker **KB5j** (authorized explicit open request from the [handoff thread](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166); scope changed from the drawn `bit-new-register-model` card and recorded in `TASK.json`): settle **Lemma BPP's without-loss question** of open problem **F-star** (`cert(M) >= floor(2v/3)` for exact 3-total rational decoders, `research/root-unit-decoder-lemmas` section 7) - the exact blocker [PR 2963](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2963) names for box-completeness: may one assume, without loss at `tau >= 1`, that an attaining L8 witness satisfies Lemma BPP conditions (i)+(ii) (odd tied-bit overlap per kept line; even off-anchor shared parity on every forward zero arc)? Equivalently: is `box(M) = cert(M)` for every exact 3-total decoder with `tau(t) >= 1` everywhere?

Package `research/fstar-box-withoutloss-seed7f3a1c/`. **F-star itself is not proved and not refuted here** (the counterexample has `cert = 3 >= 2 = floor(2v/3)`). Every claim is labelled PROVEN / CHECKED / DEMOTED.

## Verdict: the without-loss question is answered NO

**The minimal tau >= 1 counterexample, v = 3 (PROVEN; both sides exact).** Integers, exact arithmetic throughout:

```text
P = [[-1, -3,  0],        Q = [[ 1, -3,  2],
     [ 1, -1, -2],             [ 3, -1, -2],
     [ 3,  3,  3]]             [ 3, -1,  2]]

M = P Q^T = diag(8, 8, 12)          gamma = 0
tau = (2, 2, 2)                     c = (m+n) = (0, 0, 1)
a0 = [3, 3, 7]   b0 = [3, 3, 3]     (bit masks: 3 = {0,1}, 7 = {0,1,2})

cert = 3   (replayed attaining witness a = b = [1, 2, 4], order [2, 1, 0])
box  = 2   (PROVEN upper bound below; explicit box witness of 2)
```

`M` has rank 3 (exact 3-total, all three totals used), every line has `tau(t) = 2 >= 1`, and the tie/scope identities of Lemmas CT/SG hold machine-checked. Every off-diagonal pair is a zero arc. The attaining witness certifies line 2 through the **non-tied shared bit 2** (`p_2(2) = 3` is odd in `a0(2)`, but `q_2(2) = 2` has `v2 = 1 > gamma`, so bit 2 is not in `b0(2)`): Lemma BPP condition (i) fails on line 2 in every attaining witness, and the witness's sub-anchor projection drops 3 to 2.

**Why `box = 2` (PROVEN - Lemma RT and shareable totals).** Keeping `k` lines forces `K[S,S]` to have unit diagonal and zeros on all forward zero arcs; when every forward pair of the kept set is a zero arc (as here), `K[S,S]` is unit triangular over F2, so `k = rank_F2(K[S,S])`, while `K = A B^T` gives `rank_F2(K) <= r(A,B)`, the number of totals used on both label sides. In the box only **shareable** totals (`c_j = gamma`, equivalently: some `a0(t)` and some `b0(s)` both contain `j`) can enter `K`; here `c = (0,0,1)` gives `r_box = 2` (bit 2 occurs in `a0(2)` but in no `b0`), so every box witness keeps at most 2 lines. The bound is attained in-box. An independent enumeration written from the section-7 definition of `cert(M)` (not the vendored engine) recomputes `cert = 3` and `box = 2` value-by-value.

**Minimality (PROVEN).** At `v = 2`, `box = cert = 2` for every `tau >= 1` decoder (written proof: any tied pair of bits; on a double-zero pair the scope identity always supplies an auxiliary `x` in `a0(0) intersect b0(1)`, which repairs `K_01` to 0). Machine-checked on all 2842 scope-consistent `(a0, b0, Z)` patterns at `v = 2`. So `v = 3` is the smallest possible counterexample size.

## Delta

1. **PROVEN: Lemma BPP's conditions (i)+(ii) are not without loss at `tau >= 1`, and neither is line-by-line re-pairing.** The counterexample's rank bound leaves no box witness of value 3 while cert attains 3. The exact obstruction is the shareable-rank condition: a kept set of size `k` needs `k` rank in the label bits actually paired across lines, and a total with `c_j > gamma` is unshareable in the box (Lemma SB confines box labels to `a0/b0`) while full labels still reach it through non-tied shared bits.
2. **PROVEN: Lemma V2 and Lemma RT** (above), with the shareable-totals corollary `box <= r_box` whenever every forward pair of the kept set is a zero arc. Lemma RT's hypothesis is essential: with unconstrained non-zero-arc entries `det(K[S,S])` need not be 1 (this is how `tied_min` reaches `box = 11 > 3 = r_box`).
3. **CHECKED: escape classification.** PR 2963's 21 escaping events (19 distinct witnesses, v = 3..5 fixture sub-decoders) are all **cosmetic (E1)**: out-of-box bits that change no `K_tt` and no forward-arc parity; projection preserves them (0 drops, 0 box gaps). On 360 realizable `tau >= 1` instances (320 random valuation-tuned decoders, v = 3..4, plus 40 GL_3(Z) fixture transforms at v = 3), 1788 replayed witnesses project to strictly lower value (escape classes E2 1768, E1 466, E4 18, E3 6) while `box = cert` held on all 360 (0 violations). Projection-based repair is therefore not without loss even where completeness holds.
4. **CHECKED: v = 3 combinatorial enumeration.** Cert and box of a decoder depend only on `(pi, sg, Z, a0, b0)`; cert is over-approximated by the full-label value `cert_max(Z)` (monotone in label freedom). All 3023 canonical scope-consistent patterns up to line/total relabeling: 2996 with `box = cert_max`, 27 gap candidates (`cert_max = 3 > box = 2`): **3 realized** as the counterexample family above (`M` diagonal), 3 unrealizable (a total enters some `b0` with no `a0` line attaining `m_j`), 21 not realized in cap (seeded enumeration, alphabets `{+-1,+-3}/{+-2,0}` then `{+-1..+-7}/{+-2..+-6,0}`, 10,000-14,000 P-restarts with exhaustive q-rows - bounded, not a non-existence result).
5. **DEMOTED: the box-completeness link of the PR 2914 chain.** `cert = box-max` at `tau >= 1` is refuted; the surviving narrowed question is completeness on the **shareable class** (every total `c_j = gamma`), where all previous evidence sits (fixtures, PR 2936/2963 sweeps, the 360 instances here): PROVEN at `v = 2`, CHECKED at `v = 3` on all 2996 non-candidate patterns, and exactly blocked by the realizability status of the 21 remaining combinatorial patterns.

## What is proved, what is checked, what is demoted

- **PROVEN (written proofs in the package README):** Lemma V2 (box = cert = 2 at `v = 2`, `tau >= 1`); Lemma RT (triangular rank) and the shareable-totals corollary; the minimal `tau >= 1` counterexample at `v = 3` with `cert = 3 > 2 = box`; Lemma BPP conditions (i)+(ii) are not without loss at `tau >= 1`.
- **CHECKED (machine, exhaustive or replayed; stdlib, deterministic, 37 s, certificate digest `0b5b55f84375b37c`):** predecessor pins (PR 2963's 14-file pin set re-asserted plus 29 own vendored pins; fixture hashes `670ed9...`/`860647...`); predecessor anchors reproduced from pristine copies (`PASS_FG_CONTROLS`, `PASS_FG_CALIBRATION tied_min=11/12 cex_min_1=18/19 mp=9/16 chain=22 reach=0/12,8/19`; exact named RECOMPUTED = 9 on all 12 `tied_min` v = 11 sub-decoders; every stored cert/box witness replayed with in-box flags 12/12; PR 2936's `tau = 0` demo `cert = 2 > box = 1`); the counterexample re-certified three ways (engine exact, independent section-7 enumeration `3/2`, rank bound `box <= 2`); the 2842 v = 2 configs; the 3023 v = 3 configs and 27 candidates; 360 realizable instances with 0 violations and 1788 projection drops; the 19 cosmetic escapes; the 3 realizations with exact `cert`/`box`, identities and replayed witnesses.
- **DEMOTED / OPEN:** box-completeness at `tau >= 1` is **refuted**, not open. Its shareable-class form is open at `v >= 3` (21 combinatorial patterns unrealized in cap). The matched-pivot floor stays demoted. F-star is **not** proved and **not** refuted: this counterexample does not falsify it (`cert = 3 >= 2`) and leaves `cost >= cert` (PR 1590, PROVEN) untouched; the box-floor route survives as a route (`cert >= box`, and here `box = 2 = floor(2v/3)`), but no successor may assume `cert = box` without the shareable-rank condition.

## Reproduce

Standard library only, Python 3.10+ (registered replay: 3.12):

```sh
python3 -B research/fstar-box-withoutloss-seed7f3a1c/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/fstar-box-withoutloss-seed7f3a1c --check-only
```

Expected markers: `PASS_KJ_PINS pr2963-pins=14 own-pins=29`, `PASS_FG_CONTROLS`, `PASS_FG_CALIBRATION tied_min=11/12 cex_min_1=18/19 mp=9/16 chain=22 reach=0/12,8/19`, `PASS_KJ_ANCHORS named=9x12 box-replay-in-box=12/12`, `PASS_KJ_TAU0_DEMO cert=2 box=1`, `PASS_KJ_COUNTEREXAMPLE v=3 tau=2/2/2 cert=3 box=2 r_box=2 independent=3/2`, `PASS_KJ_V2 configs=2842 box-equals-cert=2842`, `PASS_KJ_V3 configs=3023 box-equals-cert=2996 candidates=27`, `PASS_KJ_REALIZABLE instances=360 box-violations=0 drops=1788`, `PASS_KJ_ESCAPE escapes=19 kinds=E1x19`, `PASS_KJ_REALIZE candidates=27 realized=3 unrealizable-column=3 not-found-in-cap=21 counterexamples=3`, `PASS_KJ_WITHOUTLOSS verdict=counterexample v=3 tau>=1 cert=3>box=2`, plus `CERTIFICATE.json` with printed digest `0b5b55f84375b37c` (observed 37 s on the authoring host; `research_package.py --check-only` prints `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS`). The replay recomputes jobs A-D and the escape classification from scratch and re-enumerates the counterexample independently of the vendored engine; checkpoint receipts under `data/` are digested into `CERTIFICATE.json` (written with `newline="\n"`).

## Exact heads and pins

Canonical main was fetched at `fadae6f469e0d5c9c03bbe047a4d383dac254448` at the pre-submission refresh; every pinned input (`docs/research/agent-task-catalog.json`, `research/root-unit-decoder-lemmas/README.md`, `certificates/selected-result.json`, `scripts/choose_research_task.py`) is byte-identical at both commits (blobs compared); only `scripts/research_package.py` changed upstream and the frozen pin is kept intentionally (PR 2914/2936/2963 precedent).
- [PR 2963](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2963) head `ee755e682b3b30d493e764d3be50003b13b69b4a`: full package tree vendored byte-exact (including its nested predecessor copies of [PR 2936](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2936) head `f0ef06f13e4de3e50c211c880bdc6891c09620a1` and [PR 2914](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2914) head `3f7781efccdf10fa61a1e0a6f11c191579b21280`), `pr-tree-extract`, SHA-256 pins in `predecessor/PINS.json`, re-verified at every replay.

## Limitations

- The 21 unrealized v = 3 combinatorial gap patterns are `not-found-in-cap`, not proven unrealizable; shareable-class box-completeness at `v = 3` is therefore CHECKED, not PROVEN.
- Lemma RT's corollary `box <= r_box` needs the all-forward-pairs-zero hypothesis; no general rank bound on `box` is claimed (the fixtures refute one).
- The witness-pool statistics (1788 drops, escape classes) are a declared generator's output (360 instances, deterministic seeds), evidence about that domain only.
- PR 2111's recorded CP-SAT certificate limits 11/18 are CHECKED (recorded), not re-verified.
